titleZh: 卡塔尔轮胎磨耗超预期，倍耐力周六维持单套 27 圈上限
titleEn: Pirelli keeps Qatar’s 27-lap limit after heavier than expected Friday wear
fullTextZh: 倍耐力检查了卡塔尔站周五练习使用的轮胎。其首席工程师西蒙尼·贝拉向 Motorsport.com 透露，车队做重油长跑时，个别轮胎约 15 圈就有局部磨耗指标达到 100%。两场练习还出现了碎石划伤轮胎的情况。
倍耐力曾考虑调整最低胎压或单套轮胎圈数。周六，PlanetF1 引述倍耐力的声明称，两项规定维持原定标准。国际汽联的赛事文件给出的单套上限为 27 圈。
卡塔尔站正赛计划跑 57 圈。两套轮胎即使各用满 27 圈也只够 54 圈，因此跑完规定距离需要至少三套轮胎。实际何时进站仍要看磨耗、赛道碎石和车队在练习收集到的数据。
fullTextEn: Pirelli found heavier wear than expected after Friday practice in Qatar. Chief engineer Simone Berra told Motorsport.com that some tyres reached 100% wear in certain areas after about 15 laps of high-fuel running. The practice tyres also showed cuts caused by gravel.

The supplier considered whether to change the minimum tyre pressures or the mileage allowed on each set. On Saturday, PlanetF1 reported that Pirelli had decided to retain both prescriptions. The FIA event notes specify a maximum of 27 laps per set.

A full Qatar Grand Prix is scheduled to run for 57 laps. Two sets used to their limit cover 54, so a driver needs at least three sets to complete that distance. Measured wear and the amount of debris on track can bring stops forward.

references.name: Autosport 对通巴西斯的采访

titleZh: FIA 研究 2030 年并用 DRS 和电力超车辅助，方案仍在模拟
titleEn: FIA studies combining DRS and push-to-pass for 2030
fullTextZh: 国际汽联正在为 2030 年动力单元规则研究超车辅助方案。单座赛车负责人尼古拉斯·通巴西斯在 Autosport 周六发布的采访中表示，模拟选项包括同时使用可减小尾翼阻力的 DRS 与短时释放电力的超车按钮。
这两项装置作用不同。打开尾翼可以降低直道阻力，电力辅助则为车手提供额外动力。通巴西斯说，模拟会帮助 FIA 判断是否需要并用，以及超车辅助应有多强。其目标是让车手带着争夺进入制动区。
FIA 已公布 2030 年动力单元拟采用的 V8 技术框架，完整规则仍待世界汽车运动理事会批准。具体超车装置、使用条件及配套细节也尚未敲定。
fullTextEn: The FIA is studying overtaking aids for the 2030 Formula 1 rules. Its single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis told Autosport that the options under simulation include using a drag-reducing rear wing together with a short burst of electrical power.

Opening the rear wing cuts drag, while push-to-pass adds power. Tombazis said the simulations would help the FIA decide whether both are needed and how much assistance to give. The aim is for drivers to contest a move into the braking zone.

The FIA has announced a framework for the next V8 power unit. The complete rules are due to go before the World Motor Sport Council, and the choice of overtaking devices and the conditions for using them remain open.

references.name: FIA 卡塔尔站周五发布会

titleZh: 沃尔斯解释威廉姆斯 2025 年支出超标，争议源于重组费用
titleEn: Vowles explains how restructuring put Williams over the 2025 cost cap
fullTextZh: 威廉姆斯领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯在卡塔尔站发布会上解释，车队对公司重组费用的处理方式，使 2025 年申报支出超过预算帽。威廉姆斯原本把相关费用视为预算帽之外的开支，FIA 则认定应纳入计算。
按照沃尔斯的说法，重组涉及把合约从一个公司实体转到另一个实体，FIA 将相关支出归入采购。国际汽联公布的协议摘要认定超额 62.7 万英镑，相当于当年限额的 0.48%，并认定同时存在程序性违规。
威廉姆斯接受了违规协议，包括缴纳罚款和减少空气动力学测试配额。FIA 称车队在审查中配合，并称没有证据表明威廉姆斯因此获得了竞技或其他优势。
fullTextEn: Williams team principal James Vowles said at the Qatar Grand Prix that the team’s treatment of corporate restructuring costs put it over the 2025 cost cap. Williams had treated the costs as outside the cap, while the FIA included them.

Vowles said the restructuring moved contracts from one company entity to another and the FIA treated the associated expense as procurement. The published agreement records an overspend of £627,000, or 0.48% of the limit, and identifies a procedural breach as well.

Williams accepted a financial penalty and a reduction in aerodynamic testing allowance. The FIA said the team had cooperated with its review and that it had found no evidence of a sporting or other advantage from the breach.

titleZh: 迈凯伦周六计划换回新版底板，诺里斯认为追赶梅赛德斯仍有差距
titleEn: Norris says McLaren’s new floor offers a step as Mercedes sets the pace
fullTextZh: 诺里斯以第三名结束卡塔尔第二次练习赛，比榜首安东内利慢 0.445 秒。皮亚斯特里排第四，只比队友慢 0.027 秒。两辆迈凯伦的排位接近，但诺里斯在周五练习后表示，梅赛德斯依然领先明显。
迈凯伦周五使用了旧版底板。车队比赛总监兰迪·辛格解释，车队看到有赛车在路肩上损伤底板，因此把新版留到周六。诺里斯预计新版底板能带来一些收益，同时认为这项改动难以填平与梅赛德斯的差距。
二练的轮胎和跑圈安排也影响了成绩表。诺里斯的最快圈来自软胎，安东内利用的是中性胎，多次红旗打断了周五的试跑。换上新底板后的第三练习和排位赛会给两辆迈凯伦更多可比数据。
fullTextEn: Lando Norris finished Qatar FP2 in third, 0.445 seconds behind Kimi Antonelli. Oscar Piastri was fourth, 0.027 seconds behind his team-mate. Norris said after practice that Mercedes still had a clear advantage.

McLaren ran its older floor on Friday. Racing director Randy Singh said the team wanted to protect the newer parts after seeing other cars damage floors over kerbs. The newer floor is due back on Saturday. Norris expects some improvement from the change and sees a larger gap to Mercedes.

Tyre choice and interrupted running complicate the Friday comparison. Norris set his best lap on softs and Antonelli used mediums. Final practice and qualifying give McLaren a chance to see how the updated floor works at Lusail.

titleZh: 红牛调整卡塔尔高速弯平衡，维斯塔潘周五两练分列第六和第五
titleEn: Red Bull tackles understeer after Verstappen’s difficult Friday at Lusail
fullTextZh: 维斯塔潘在卡塔尔站一练排第六，二练升至第五。队友哈贾尔一练第三，二练第六。维斯塔潘赛后把圈速损失的一部分归因于赛车平衡，称赛车前后反应还不够协调。
红牛技术总监皮埃尔·瓦谢表示，两辆车在一练均出现比预期更明显的转向不足，维斯塔潘受影响更大。车队在二练前做了调整，方向有所改善，但仍有取舍。瓦谢在接受 Motorsport.com 采访时，把问题指向中高速弯对前部的要求，同时强调调整需要兼顾入弯稳定性。
梅赛德斯包揽周五两场练习的前两名。红牛在排位赛前有一节练习可以复核改动，尤其是看看前轴响应好转之后，入弯时的稳定性是否还能维持。
fullTextEn: Max Verstappen finished sixth in Qatar’s opening practice and fifth in FP2. Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar went from third to sixth. Verstappen attributed some of the time loss to the car’s balance, describing a lack of connection between its front and rear.

Technical director Pierre Waché said both cars had more understeer than expected in FP1, with Verstappen affected more. Changes before FP2 helped at the cost of some compromises. Waché told Motorsport.com that the team needed to improve the front end through medium- and high-speed corners while maintaining stability on entry.

Mercedes finished one-two in both Friday sessions. Red Bull has one more practice before qualifying to check whether further work on the front end can improve rotation without making the car harder to manage on the way into a corner.

titleZh: 勒克莱尔二练打转换底板，法拉利仍在追查卡塔尔速度问题
titleEn: Ferrari searches for pace after Leclerc’s Qatar practice spin and floor change
fullTextZh: 卡塔尔大奖赛周五两场练习，勒克莱尔均排第七，汉密尔顿均排第八。法拉利在第二场还损失了一段跑圈时间。勒克莱尔驶出七号弯时打转，车队随后更换了赛车底板。
勒克莱尔向媒体说明了损伤的先后顺序。他此前驶过路肩时已经损坏底板，滑进砂石区后损伤加重。更换底板让他少跑了几圈中性胎，即便后来换上软胎，成绩也没有明显改善。
维修只解释了部分跑圈损失。勒克莱尔表示，法拉利当天在轻油和重油条件下都缺少速度。他也提到，梅赛德斯的优势大过预期，究竟是对手在卢赛尔特别快，还是法拉利本身没有发挥出赛车的速度，需要继续看数据。
第二练习赛的官方成绩给出了排位赛前的参照。安东内利和拉塞尔包揽前两名，诺里斯第三。法拉利周六还有第三场练习，可以用来复核周五发现的问题。
fullTextEn: Charles Leclerc finished seventh in both Friday practices in Qatar, with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton eighth in each. Leclerc also lost running in the second session after spinning at the exit of Turn 7. Ferrari replaced the floor before he returned to the track.

Leclerc said a kerb had damaged the floor earlier in the session and the trip through the gravel made it worse. The change reduced his time on the medium tyres. He did not find a meaningful improvement when he later switched to the softs.

The repair accounted for some lost running, while Leclerc described a broader pace problem on both low and high fuel. He also said the size of Mercedes’ advantage was unusual. Ferrari still had to establish how much of the gap came from its own performance at Lusail.

The final FP2 classification put Kimi Antonelli and George Russell first and second for Mercedes, with Lando Norris third. The third practice session gives Ferrari another chance to check its findings before qualifying.

titleZh: 加斯利谈卡塔尔二练打转：轮胎温度偏低，赛车出现触底
titleEn: Gasly points to cool tyres and bottoming after Qatar FP2 spin
fullTextZh: 卡塔尔大奖赛第二次练习赛中，加斯利驾驶 Alpine 赛车高速打转后陷入砂石区。赛会出示红旗，工作人员清理车辆后才恢复计时。这是这场练习赛的第二次红旗。
加斯利赛后向 F1 官网解释，当时轮胎温度偏低，赛车也比预想更容易触底。他把两者列为失控的相关因素。第一次红旗期间的等待打断了跑圈节奏，重新出场后，轮胎需要重新进入工作温度。
卢赛尔的高速弯对车身稳定性要求较高。加斯利的事故让 Alpine 少了一段二练时间，也给车队留下一个具体的检查项目：回看触底和轮胎温度各自在失控前如何变化。
fullTextEn: Pierre Gasly brought out the second red flag of Qatar’s second practice when he spun at high speed and his Alpine became stranded in the gravel. Running resumed after the car was recovered.

Speaking to Formula 1 after practice, Gasly pointed to low tyre temperatures and more bottoming than he had expected. The earlier stoppage had broken up the running and drivers had to bring their tyres back up to temperature when they returned to the circuit.

Alpine lost track time with Gasly in a session that had already been interrupted. His account identifies two areas for the team to review before running resumes: how the floor behaved over the circuit and how quickly the tyres warmed after the restart.

titleZh: 国际上诉法院驳回奥迪申诉，意大利大奖赛原裁决维持
titleEn: FIA court dismisses Audi’s appeal over the Italian Grand Prix start
fullTextZh: 国际汽联国际上诉法院在 11 月 25 日于巴黎听取奥迪的申诉，并于 11 月 27 日公布裁决结果。奥迪针对 2026 年意大利大奖赛赛会第 69 号决定提出的申诉被驳回。
争议发生在蒙扎站正赛起步程序中，涉及角田裕毅是否应在额外暖胎圈后从维修区末端起步。赛会在赛后调查了运动规则第 B5.9.4 条的适用情况，当时决定不采取进一步行动。
本次裁决维持了赛会原决定。奥迪两名车手博托莱托和霍肯伯格在该场比赛分别排名第十一和第十二。国际汽联此次公布的是裁决结果，详细理由将另行发布。
fullTextEn: The FIA International Court of Appeal dismissed Audi’s challenge to decision 69 of the stewards at the 2026 Italian Grand Prix. The hearing took place in Paris on 25 November and the court announced the outcome on 27 November.

The case concerned the start procedure at Monza and whether Yuki Tsunoda had to start from the end of the pit lane after an extra formation lap. The stewards examined the application of article B5.9.4 after the race and took no further action.

The dismissal leaves the original decision in place. Audi drivers Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hülkenberg had finished 11th and 12th respectively. The FIA released the operative decision and said its detailed reasons would follow.

titleZh: 安东内利用中性胎领跑卡塔尔一练，拉塞尔落后 0.507 秒
titleEn: Antonelli sets the Qatar FP1 benchmark on mediums, 0.507s ahead of Russell
fullTextZh: 安东内利在卢赛尔用中性胎跑出 1:23.217，成为卡塔尔大奖赛一练最快车手。同队的拉塞尔落后 0.507 秒，红牛车手哈贾尔落后 0.661 秒。哈贾尔与拉塞尔之间实际只差 0.154 秒。
这节练习的最快圈来自中性胎。它说明梅赛德斯在一练条件下有速度。比较两位车手的最终成绩时，轮胎配方、剩余圈数和下一个计时圈的路面条件都会影响比较。
卡塔尔站每套轮胎的 27 圈限额跨场次累积，练习用掉的圈数也要计入。二练在当地 20:00、北京时间次日 01:00 开始。随着赛道转入夜间，车队还要在尝试单圈速度和为后续场次保留可用轮胎之间取舍。
迈凯伦的诺里斯和皮亚斯特里分列第四、第五，两人的差距只有 0.010 秒，维斯塔潘第六。这给二练留下了两项可比较的数据：迈凯伦两车能否缩小与榜首的差距，以及梅赛德斯换到另一种轮胎后能否保持优势。
fullTextEn: Kimi Antonelli put Mercedes on top in Qatar’s opening practice with a 1:23.217 on medium tyres. George Russell was 0.507 seconds behind and Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar was 0.661 seconds off the benchmark, leaving just 0.154 seconds between second and third.

That leading lap came on the medium compound. The timesheets show what each driver achieved in FP1, while compound, remaining tyre mileage and changing track conditions all matter when comparing subsequent runs.

The 27-lap limit per tyre set is cumulative across sessions at Lusail. Second practice starts at 20:00 local time, or 01:00 the following day in Beijing. With the circuit moving into night conditions, teams have to balance further single-lap tests against saving tyre mileage for the rest of the weekend.

McLaren took fourth and fifth with Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri separated by just 0.010 seconds. Max Verstappen was sixth. Two comparisons to watch in FP2 are whether both McLarens close the gap to the front and how Mercedes fares on a different compound.

titleZh: 贝尔曼确定留在哈斯，2027 年将搭档卡马拉
titleEn: Bearman stays at Haas for 2027 alongside Câmara
fullTextZh: 哈斯在卡塔尔大奖赛前确定，奥利弗·贝尔曼将代表车队参加 2027 年 F1 世界锦标赛。这将是他连续第三年作为哈斯正式车手参赛。拉斐尔·卡马拉的席位此前已确认，车队两名车手由此都已确定。
两人已经开始合作。卡马拉在今年圣保罗站首次为哈斯出赛，车队把赛季最后几站安排给他，为下赛季的全职参赛做准备。相比等到明年揭幕战才建立配合，哈斯现在就能用比赛周末检验两名车手的反馈和调校方向。
据哈斯公告，续约宣布时贝尔曼已在 F1 正赛发车 48 次，职业生涯累计 71 分。他为哈斯取得的代表性成绩包括 2025 年墨西哥城站第四，以及 2026 年中国站第五。
这次确认的是 2027 年哈斯席位。对卡马拉而言，下赛季首次完整参赛时会有一名熟悉车队的队友作参照。对贝尔曼而言，第三个赛季能检验他能否把偶尔的高位完赛转化为更稳定的得分。
fullTextEn: Haas has confirmed Oliver Bearman for the 2027 Formula 1 championship ahead of the Qatar Grand Prix. It will be his third consecutive full season with the team. Rafael Câmara had already been named for the other seat, completing the pairing.

They have already started working together. Câmara made his debut for Haas in São Paulo this year and was given the closing rounds to prepare for his first full campaign. Haas can use those weekends to compare feedback and setup preferences before next season begins.

Haas counted 48 Grand Prix starts and 71 career points for Bearman at the time of the announcement. His stand-out results for the team include fourth in Mexico City in 2025 and fifth in China in 2026.

The announcement confirms Bearman’s Haas seat for 2027. For Câmara, that means a benchmark from a team-mate who already knows the operation. For Bearman, the next step is turning his strongest finishes into more regular scoring.

titleZh: 卡塔尔站单套轮胎最多跑 27 圈，跑满正赛至少换胎两次
titleEn: Qatar’s 27-lap tyre limit means at least two changes over full race distance
fullTextZh: 倍耐力确认，卡塔尔大奖赛干胎分配为 C1 硬胎、C2 中性胎和 C3 软胎。单套轮胎最多允许使用 27 圈。这比上赛季本站每套 25 圈的上限多了两圈。
正赛计划跑 57 圈。两套轮胎即使都用到上限，也只够跑 54 圈。因此，在干地条件下跑满原定距离时，车手需要使用至少三套轮胎，完成至少两次换胎。若只看这一上限，第二套用到第 54 圈之际，仍需为最后三圈留下第三套。
卢赛尔的高速弯会持续向轮胎施加横向负载，倍耐力预计左前轮尤其容易磨损。本站没有冲刺赛。三场练习将给车队更多时间比较不同干胎在长距离下的衰减、磨损和工作温度。
fullTextEn: Pirelli confirmed C1 as Qatar’s hard tyre, C2 as the medium and C3 as the soft. Each set can be used for a maximum of 27 laps, two more than the limit at last year’s race.

The race is scheduled for 57 laps. Two sets used to the limit would cover only 54, so drivers completing the full distance in dry conditions need at least three sets and two tyre changes. On the lap limit alone, a driver who reaches lap 54 on two sets still needs a third for the final three laps.

Lusail’s fast corners load the tyres laterally for extended periods, and Pirelli expects particularly high wear on the front left. There is no Sprint this weekend, so the three practice sessions give teams more time to compare the wear, degradation and operating temperatures of their dry compounds over longer runs.

titleZh: FIA 公布卡塔尔站发布会名单，勒克莱尔和皮亚斯特里周四出席
titleEn: FIA names Leclerc and Piastri among Qatar’s Thursday press conference guests
fullTextZh: FIA 公布了卡塔尔大奖赛赛前发布会名单。北京时间 11 月 26 日 22:30，贝尔曼、拉塞尔和哈贾尔先出席。23:00 开始的第二组由佩雷兹、勒克莱尔和皮亚斯特里出席，两组各有三名车手。
车队代表的发布会安排在当地时间周五晚，也就是北京时间 11 月 27 日 23:30。哈斯的小松礼雄、红牛的劳伦特·梅基斯和威廉姆斯的詹姆斯·沃尔斯将参加。
周六排位赛和周日正赛结束后，两个场次各自的前三名车手再出席赛后发布会。赛前名单与赛后安排分开，后者由现场成绩决定。
fullTextEn: The FIA has named the guests for Qatar’s pre-event press conferences. Oliver Bearman, George Russell and Isack Hadjar are scheduled first, at 17:30 local time on Thursday 26 November. Sergio Pérez, Charles Leclerc and Oscar Piastri follow at 18:00.
The team representatives’ session is scheduled for 18:30 local time on Friday 27 November. Ayao Komatsu will attend for Haas, Laurent Mekies for Red Bull and James Vowles for Williams.

After qualifying on Saturday, the three fastest drivers will attend the post-session conference. Sunday’s race conference is reserved for the first three finishers, so the final attendance depends on the classifications.

titleZh: 加斯利有望在卢赛尔迎来第 199 次 F1 正赛发车
titleEn: Gasly is set to make his 199th Grand Prix start at Lusail
fullTextZh: Alpine 在卡塔尔站前确认，若加斯利按计划参加正赛，这将是他的第 199 次大奖赛发车，追平法国车手阿兰·普罗斯特的发车次数。
加斯利与科拉平托在上一站拉斯维加斯分获第五和第六，为 Alpine 带回 18 分。按车队统计，这是他们自 2024 年圣保罗站以来两辆车在单场大奖赛拿到的最高积分。加斯利此前最近一次进入前五正是在 2024 年的卡塔尔站。
截至本站赛前，Alpine 赛季积分达到 87 分，等于车队在 2024 和 2025 两个赛季的合计。卢赛尔还曾见证车队的领奖台成绩，阿隆索在 2021 年获得第三。
fullTextEn: Alpine says Pierre Gasly will make his 199th Grand Prix start if he lines up for Sunday’s Qatar race. That would draw him level with fellow French driver Alain Prost on starts.

Gasly finished fifth and Franco Colapinto sixth in Las Vegas, scoring 18 points between them. Alpine says it was the team’s biggest single-Grand-Prix return since São Paulo in 2024. Gasly’s previous top-five finish also came at Lusail, in 2024.

The Las Vegas result took Alpine to 87 points for the season, matching its combined total for 2024 and 2025. The team has also finished on the Qatar podium before, when Fernando Alonso took third at the inaugural race in 2021.

titleZh: 奥迪距车队积分榜第七仅差 3 分，卡塔尔力争重返积分区
titleEn: Audi heads to Qatar three points off seventh in the constructors’ championship
fullTextZh: 奥迪在卡塔尔站前的通报中称，车队距离积分榜第七名还有 3 分。赛季只剩卢赛尔和阿布扎比两站，霍肯伯格和博托莱托都将争取在卡塔尔进入前十。
两辆奥迪在拉斯维加斯分别以第 11 和第 12 名完赛，刚好排在积分区外。卢赛尔是一条高速弯更密集的赛道，车队赛事总监艾伦·麦克尼什把轮胎管理和比赛执行列为本站重点。
本站执行单套轮胎 27 圈的限制，车队在制定进站计划时除了考虑衰减，还要核算每套轮胎的可用圈数。对于处在积分区边缘的两辆车，进站后能否避开车流也会影响追分机会。
fullTextEn: Audi’s Qatar preview puts the team three points behind seventh in the constructors’ standings. With only Lusail and Abu Dhabi left on the calendar, Nico Hülkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto are aiming for a return to the top ten.

The two Audis finished 11th and 12th in Las Vegas, just outside the points. Lusail presents a different challenge with its sustained fast corners. Audi racing director Allan McNish singled out tyre management and race execution as priorities.

Qatar’s 27-lap limit for each set adds a mileage calculation to the usual assessment of tyre degradation. For cars fighting near the edge of the points, whether they rejoin in clear air after a pit stop can also affect the chances of scoring.

titleZh: 迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯拿到 33 分，皮亚斯特里从第 17 位登台
titleEn: McLaren takes 33 points as Piastri climbs from 17th to the Las Vegas podium
fullTextZh: 迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯拿到双领奖台，诺里斯第二，皮亚斯特里第三。两人分别拿到 18 和 15 分，为车队带回 33 分。
皮亚斯特里从第 17 位发车。迈凯伦在赛后报告中确认，比赛暂停给了两辆车换上中性胎的机会。皮亚斯特里随后将追赶转化为第三名，比发车位置提升了 14 位。
诺里斯冲线时落后维斯塔潘 0.639 秒，两辆迈凯伦之间相隔 0.890 秒。两名车手均跑完 50 圈，车队由此在赛季倒数第三站拿到本场第 2 和第 3 名的全部积分。
fullTextEn: McLaren left Las Vegas with both drivers on the podium. Lando Norris finished second for 18 points and Oscar Piastri took third for 15, giving the team 33 points in the Grand Prix.

Piastri started 17th. McLaren’s race report confirms that a suspension of racing gave both cars the opportunity to switch to medium tyres. Piastri converted his recovery into third place, a gain of 14 positions on his grid slot.

Norris crossed the line 0.639 seconds behind winner Max Verstappen, with a further 0.890 seconds separating the two McLarens. Both completed all 50 laps and collected the full points available for second and third.
